notes.title: Version 0.2.3
notes.content:
[h1]Version 0.2.3[/h1]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
- World 3 - Egypt added ( + 5 new levels )
- 2 new levels added in the Wild West world
- Cowgirl added in world 2 ( she collects all coins that spawn in the world )
- added mummy in world 3 ( she collects all golden cows )
- Info signs at the beginning of each level inform you about the rules and changes in the world
- Level signs set up
- New songs added

[h2]Gameplay changes[/h2]
- yellow cows in world 2 are now worth 10 coins
- yellow cows in world 3 are now worth 15 coins

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
- Egypt is no longer finished with Game Over
- Camera angle was limited
- the camera can now be rotated again without stopping at the edge of the screen
- missing translation added
- Fixed bug with light effects 
- Error in cloud fixed
- Cows no longer spawn at unreachable points
- Cows no longer spawn within themselves

notes.title: Version 0.2.2
notes.content:
- Position in the level is saved and player ends up at last position in the level selector
- Hans is no longer spinning in the level selection
- at level 5 and 6 the wrong coin number was deducted
- Shop inserted in world 1
- Trap can be bought in the shop
- Music added to the main menu

notes.title: New version released
notes.content:
This update fixes some bugs, adds the Wild West world and an English translation.

These are the changes in detail:
+ New map added (Wild West) with 2 levels
+ English language added
* Bugfix in the calculation of coins when changing to level 5 fixed

notes.title: New version released
notes.content:
This small update fixes some bugs and adds a new pause menu.

These are the changes in detail:
  New break menu added
* Troubleshooting Coins (Coins were not deducted when unlocking the level)
* Alpha wall removed at the beginning
* Escape in Level Selector no longer calls up the pause menu but the main menu
